Home.reason: the utility's index/navigation page — Yukti's left index replaces it; no schedule, no schema block

Part A Gen_139(8A).reason: the 139(8A) updated-return variant of Part A-General — not applicable to an original return

Schedule K.reason: hidden Statement of particulars regarding author(s)/founder(s)/trustee(s)/manager(s) — no schema block in ITR-7's block list; not filed as a schedule this year

Schedule ER.reason: hidden application detail (establishment & administrative expenses) — feeds Schedule A; no schema block of its own in ITR-7's list

Schedule EC.reason: hidden application detail (capital account / capital work in progress) — feeds Schedule A; no schema block of its own in ITR-7's list

Schedule CGold.reason: hidden superseded prior-version Capital Gains table; the current Schedule CG sheet is built

Sheet1.reason: hidden utility scratch sheet (0 rows) — no schedule, no schema block

Part B ATI.reason: hidden Part B-ATI is the updated-return (139(8A) / 140B) computation — no schema block in ITR-7's list, not applicable to an original return

CG Pop up_prefill.reason: hidden capital-gains prefill pop-up helper — Schedule CG is built from the visible CG sheet; no separate schema block

TaxCalc(N).why_built: the hidden basic-tax computation sheet (new-regime / status-wise rates and surcharge) — the method behind Part B-TTI; read, not shown (rule 7)

TaxCalc.why_built: the hidden tax and interest computation sheet — the method behind Part B-TTI and the 234A/B/C interest; read, not shown (rule 7)

SUMMARY.reason: hidden internal preview / summary sheet — no schedule, no schema block

Temporary Values.reason: hidden utility scratch / temporary values — no schedule

DataBase.reason: hidden master lookup data (pincodes, dropdown lists) — data, not a schedule

Instructions.reason: the utility's instructions text — not a schedule
